Method of Attack: Sandbox escape via exception sanitization flaw in handleException() allowing unsanitized host exception to be raised
Custom getPrototypeOf() proxy handler throwing unsanitized host exception to bypass sandbox restrictions
Arbitrary code execution on host by escaping sandbox
Discoverer: SeungHyun Lee (Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology - KAIST)
Impacted Systems: Software tools using VM2 JavaScript sandbox
Attack Vector: Exploitation of sandbox escape vulnerabilities in VM2 library
Malicious code execution inside sandbox environment leading to host code execution
Indicators of Compromise: Proof of concept exploit creating a file named 'pwned' on the host
Publicly available PoC on GitHub repository
